decision.basis: Six mandatory searches complete. Supplemental apparel search and direct Crazy Dog comparison show same What's Crackin wording plus lobster/claw cracking punchline. Generic slang alone is not the basis. Native family copy promotes Outer Banks exposure and warns of knockoffs; neither supplies a resolved independent creator chain.
